sheets.title: ELECTRICAL — PARTIAL SITE PLAN - AREA 5
sheets.source_file: E14_ Pull Plan PARTIAL SITE PLAN - AREA 5 Rev.6 markup.pdf
sheets.reading_notes: Single-sheet electrical site plan at 1"=20' scale showing underground conduit routing across the Nansemond Treatment Plant site, Area 5. Red-ink markup annotations added by BFA/engineer for wire pull planning: (1) Two pulls labeled 'Pull A' and 'Pull B' identified with wire size '3-500KCMIL (5kV) & 1-#1 GRD 600V'; (2) conduit routing noted through manholes and process areas including Pre-Dewatering Building (PA 130), Grit Tanks (PA 120), WASSTRIP (PA 110), SNIR (PA 820); (3) 'Insert Pulley in manhole E-30' noted; (4) dimension annotations of 4', 61', 81' for conduit run segments; (5) per RFI 224, rerouting noted near Dewatering Building; (6) annotation references WCD 4 for High Mast Light 6 Power Re-route; (7) Note 1 references tee splice of 5kV cables in manhole serving Unit Substation USS-1. Hazen and Sawyer is EOR. Drawing shows interface between existing ductbank E-33-0104/0106/0107 and proposed conduit system. Scale 1"=20'. Conformed set with field order revisions to FO No. 18 (11-2023). Key plan inset shows Area 5 location within broader plant site.
